defects.what: The flag hanging from the left scale pan is a blue-and-white diagonal flag with a white star, not the Philippine flag the narration about Philippine drug law calls for.
Large pseudo-text signs ('OOUIENZ' top left, 'FENGU' top right) and a smaller lettered poster hang on the pawnshop walls behind Indio.
A second topknotted young man in a grey tee, a near copy of Indio, stands behind the counter at right, so Indio appears twice.
A girl's disembodied head grows out of the top of the chart paper on the desk, a face on an object.
The bar chart's axis carries small pseudo-text tick labels on the left.
The open notebook in Indio's hands is filled with rows of pseudo-text glyphs at the center of the frame.
The whole picture is framed as a phone screen with a black bezel border around the edge, a frame inside the frame.
The heart-shaped heart-rate widget at lower right shows small pseudo-text readouts beside the graph.
A large upside-down yellow dog-like creature hangs from a tree at upper left, a malformed figure that draws the eye.
Usman is drawn as a fluffy spitz with both ears pricked up instead of a short-coated street dog with one folded ear.
The young man filming the Bakunawa at lower right, Indio's own memory, has brown messy hair, blue eyes and no topknot, so he reads as a different character.
Indio at right has short loose hair with no topknot and a long black tee, and Usman at left has both ears pricked with almost no white chest patch.
Indio at right has no topknot and wears a long-sleeved grey-blue henley.
Indio holding Usman has short loose hair with no topknot and a black collared shirt.
Usman at lower left has both ears hanging (no single folded ear) and only a tiny white chest spot.
Indio standing in the rainy street at right has no topknot.
Shop signs on the left buildings, including a yellow sign at top left, carry pseudo-text lettering.
The shop signs at upper left and right of the street and the motorbike tank carry pseudo-text lettering.
The bottles on the shelves behind Indio have labels with small pseudo-text.
A faint scribble of pseudo-handwriting sits in the middle of the notebook page.
Several cars in the garage have recognisable maker-style kidney grilles and front badges.
The shot is three framed pictures hanging on a dark wall, which puts frames inside the frame.
